scientific_question: Can the existing hidden64+24 c_proj Givens budget close its residual loss gap when projection is measured in a bounded diagonal approximation to the post-GELU functional metric rather than unweighted Frobenius geometry?

cproj_only_terminal_result.fact: c_proj-only terminal CE 3.6562013626 is within 0.00404167 of joint full-MLP CE but 0.02840136 behind repaired attention; c_fc is not the primary incremental bottleneck.

excluded_prior_output_metric.fact: The full correlated activation metric on output-side coordinates amplified angles and produced roughly 33x held-out residual-stream error; it must not be repeated.

unchanged: c_proj materialized weight and hidden-side 64 parent plus 24 residual stages
fresh matching every update with 64 neighbors
main learning rate, schedule, data order, evaluation windows, and seeds
zero additional trainable parameters and zero inference-time transforms
single_factor_change.changed: Only c_proj hidden-side pair selection and angle fitting use the registered bounded diagonal post-GELU activation-energy metric.

metric_definition.observation: For each layer and optimizer update, accumulate the per-channel sum of squared post-GELU c_proj inputs over all training microbatches; evaluation activations are excluded.
metric_definition.initialization: The first optimizer update initializes the persistent EMA exactly to that update's aggregate second moment; later updates use decay 0.95.
metric_definition.normalization: Divide the EMA by its channel mean, clamp to [0.25,4.0], and add no learned scale.
metric_definition.weighted_pair_formula: For source columns a,b, requested columns u,v, and metric weights q_a,q_b, theta=(q_b<a,v>-q_a<b,u>)/(q_a||b||^2+q_b||a||^2).
metric_definition.weighted_selector_formula: Pair scores use abs(q_b<a,v>-q_a<b,u>) before the unchanged deterministic top-neighbor edge coloring.
metric_definition.passes: Use one fixed metric vector for both parent and fresh residual passes of an optimizer update; apply the fitted rotations to the unscaled materialized weight.
metric_definition.state: EMA, initialization flag, and update count are persistent exact-resume buffers; transient microbatch sums are consumed and cleared at optimizer.step().

required_diagnostics: metric minimum, maximum, mean, and condition number
native matching path and source hash

requirements: default-off state and update bitwise equivalence
state_dict and optimizer exact-resume round trip
config validation and model wiring tests

performance_gate.protocol: Foreground exact-scientific-config run with one warmup plus eight timed real training updates; poll directly and use no watchdog.

decision_rule.promote_action: If terminal CE is at most 3.6478 with finite metric diagnostics and no material performance regression, classify the functional metric as a causal c_proj improvement and preregister a smallest-rung confirmation or next closure step.
decision_rule.insufficient_action: If terminal CE is above 3.6478, do not tune metric decay or bounds post hoc and do not launch another language-model arm from this family; seal the result and return to a structurally different c_proj representation.
